criterion: Division routes and the roster sit on a near-black neutral ground, headings read white, and the running sentences a visitor reads are set in one mid neutral grey.
evaluation_rule: Open Creator Media and the roster in dark mode. Answer yes when the ground is near-black, headings are white and body paragraphs, the clock and count lines are a mid grey distinct from the white. Answer no when body copy is white like the headings, when the ground is a colour or a light shade, or when one colour family dominates a page with nothing else to tell parts apart.

criterion: The four division colours appear as a vivid red for Creator Media, a soft green for Creator Communities, a vivid blue for Creator Products and a vivid amber yellow for Creator Tech, and only on each division's own menu line, roster card division line, filter value and join control.
evaluation_rule: Open the menu overlay, the roster with cards from several divisions, and the join us page. Answer yes when each division keeps its one colour in every one of those places and those four colours colour nothing unrelated to a division, such as buttons, headings or links. Answer no when a division changes colour between places, when two divisions share a colour, or when a division colour decorates something that is not that division.

criterion: Headings on the division routes rise into place line by line, each line a moment after the one above, and the hand-drawn strokes under menu links draw from one end to the other.
evaluation_rule: Open Creator Tech and scroll so its headings enter the window, then open the menu and point at a division link. Answer yes when heading lines rise one after another from below into place and the stroke is drawn along its length. Answer no when headings appear all at once, fade in as a whole block, or the stroke simply fades in.

criterion: Pointing at a pill control on the join us page grows a filled ellipse out from the pill's centre with the label crossing to the ground colour, a link's text changes colour ahead of the mark beside the link, and a pending control shows a turning ring in place of the label.
evaluation_rule: Point at the Apply pill and at a footer link, then send the application to see a pending state. Answer yes when the pill fill grows as an ellipse from the middle, the link text colour shifts before its mark and a turning ring replaces the label while pending. Answer no when the fill slides in from an edge or appears instantly, link text and mark change together, or a pending control keeps its label.

criterion: Form fields in the application and the profile editor are single underlines, roster cards and panels carry edges made only of colour changes, and the consent card is the one rounded card in the product.
evaluation_rule: Open the application slide-over, the profile editor and the roster. Answer yes when every field is an underline, cards and panels have no drop shadow or outline border, and apart from pills and the toggle track only the consent card has rounded corners. Answer no when a field is a boxed input, a card carries a shadow or a border, or other rounded cards appear.

criterion: The armillary on the front door looks machined: dark brushed metal rings with a roll of light along each ring around a high-gloss black sphere reflecting the rings, first seen through spectral colour fringes that converge as the object settles.
evaluation_rule: Load the front door and watch the object arrive, then look at the settled object. Answer yes when the rings read as dark metal catching a band of light, the centre sphere is glossy black with visible reflections, and colour fringes during arrival resolve to a clean image. Answer no when the rings look flat or plastic, the sphere is matte, fringes remain after settling, or the object is a flat picture.

criterion: Each division route shows its own scene object behind the content, in the same dark metal and black glass as the armillary: a fanned stack of thin discs for Creator Media, a ring of small connected spheres for Creator Communities, four nested rounded boxes for Creator Products and a rippled glass sphere for Creator Tech, with the foot of each scene fading into the ground.
evaluation_rule: Open the four division routes and scroll a little on each. Answer yes when each shows the named object behind its text, moving with the scroll, in the shared dark materials, and the bottom of the scene fades into the page ground. Answer no when a division has no scene, shows a different object, uses a photograph or a new material, or the scene ends on a hard edge.

criterion: The Halden wordmark and the Menu control in the bar invert against whatever sits behind them, reading light over the near-black ground and dark over a light scene or light mode.
evaluation_rule: Scroll a division route over light and dark parts of its scene and switch to light mode. Answer yes when the wordmark and the menu control flip between light and dark with the background so they stay readable everywhere. Answer no when they keep one fixed colour and become hard to read over some background.

criterion: The profile editor and the review queue wear the same near-black ground, type faces, pills and spacing as the public roster, reading as the roster with working controls.
evaluation_rule: Sign in as a creator to open the profile editor, then as the curator to open the review queue. Answer yes when both use the public site's ground, type, underline fields and pill controls with calm, sparse layouts. Answer no when either looks like a separate admin dashboard with a different colour scheme, boxed tables, a sidebar of stock widgets or a second design language.

criterion: Text on the front door, the roster and the profile editor meets WCAG AA contrast in both light and dark mode, every control offers a target of at least 44 CSS pixels, each route has one first-level heading, and focus stays inside the open menu or palette until the overlay closes.
evaluation_rule: Inspect the three surfaces in both modes, measure the small bar controls, count first-level headings, and tab through the open menu and palette. Answer yes when every text pair meets AA, the Menu control and toggle are at least 44 CSS pixels in both directions, one first-level heading exists per route and focus loops within the open overlay. Answer no when any of these is missing.

criterion: With the reduced-motion preference on, the front door and the division routes keep every piece of content reachable, with headings appearing at rest, strokes appear complete, the route curtain is skipped and the armillary steps one segment at a time.
evaluation_rule: Emulate a reduced-motion preference, load the front door, step the armillary and enter a division. Answer yes when headings show at once in place, strokes are already drawn, entering the division skips the curtain and the armillary jumps between segments with everything still usable. Answer no when headings still animate in, the curtain still sweeps, or some content or control becomes unreachable.

criterion: The roster grid shows three columns with the middle column lower on a wide screen, two columns with the second lower on a mid-width screen, and one column on a phone, with the page scrolling vertically only.
evaluation_rule: Open the roster at a wide, a tablet and a phone width. Answer yes when the column count steps from three to two to one and the offset column sits lower wherever there is more than one column, with no sideways scrolling. Answer no when the grid keeps three columns on a phone, loses the offset, or scrolls sideways.

criterion: On a phone-width screen a creator profile runs in one column with the portrait across the full width, and the application slide-over spans the full width with labels above fields.
evaluation_rule: Open Juno Okafor's profile and the application at a phone width. Answer yes when the profile stacks in one column with a full-width portrait and the application panel fills the width with labels above each field. Answer no when either keeps a side-by-side layout, overflows sideways or leaves the panel as a narrow sliver.

criterion: A roster card or creator profile whose portrait address cannot load shows a generated still of the division object with the person's initials centred on the still.
evaluation_rule: Open the roster and Juno Okafor's profile, where portrait addresses point at an external media origin that may fail to load. Answer yes when each portrait that does not load is replaced by a generated image carrying the person's initials. Answer no when a broken-image icon, an empty box or alt text alone shows in its place.

criterion: Loading on the roster, a division route and the profile editor shows still skeleton blocks the size of the coming content, empty or failed collections show one centred notice with a heading, one line and at most one control, and form messages appear only after leaving a field or sending the form.
evaluation_rule: Throttle the network and load the roster and a division, filter the roster to Partnerships, and type into the application slowly. Answer yes when loading shows unmoving placeholder blocks, the empty result shows a single centred notice with one control, and field messages wait until the field is left or Send is pressed. Answer no when placeholders shimmer or pulse, content jumps as it lands, an empty state carries several controls or an illustration, or messages flash while typing.

criterion: Light mode on the front door and the roster swaps the ground and text so every grey, mark and icon inverts with the mode and every surface stays legible, with the four division colours unchanged.
evaluation_rule: Switch to light mode and view the front door, the menu, the roster and a profile. Answer yes when the page reads light with dark text, greys and marks inverted, every label readable and the division colours the same as in dark mode. Answer no when light mode is a filter over the dark design, some text or icon disappears against the light ground, or division colours change.

criterion: A failure surface on the roster, a creator profile or the application shows a raw status code such as 404 or a machine error token such as validation_failed to the person.
evaluation_rule: Open an unknown profile slug, send an invalid application and a duplicate application. Answer yes when any visible text shows a numeric status code or a machine error token. Answer no when every failure is written as plain sentences such as Not here. or That address already has an account.

criterion: The front door headline and every division title are set in a condensed display face in capitals, sentences and controls in a grotesk, and the hand-drawn face appears only once sketch mode is on.
evaluation_rule: Look at the front door headline, a division route's titles and body text, then turn on sketch mode. Answer yes when headings use a narrow condensed face in capitals, body and controls use a different sans face, and a handwriting face appears only with sketch mode on. Answer no when headings and body share one face, headings are lowercase in a wide face, or the handwriting face shows with sketch mode off.

criterion: Interface marks such as the globe, camera, document and close cross on a creator profile and in the bar are thin outlines drawn on one small square, taking the colour of the element holding each mark.
evaluation_rule: Open Juno Okafor's profile and the menu overlay and look at every small icon. Answer yes when icons are thin single-weight outlines of a common size that change colour with their surroundings and the mode. Answer no when icons are filled, multicoloured, of mixed styles or fetched pictures.

criterion: The arrival screen counter on the front door advances with actual loading and stalls when loading stalls, and after twenty seconds of stalling a control appears that continues into the site with the list fallback.
evaluation_rule: Load the front door on a throttled connection and again with the scene requests blocked. Answer yes when the counter moves unevenly with loading, stops when requests stop, and a Continue without the scene control appears after about twenty seconds and opens the site. Answer no when the counter runs smoothly to 100 on a fixed timer regardless of loading, or a stalled arrival offers no way in.

criterion: When the front door cannot render the three-dimensional armillary, the page shows the four division names as a list of large lines with their coloured lines, the arrow keys still step the acquired name, and Enter still opens that division.
evaluation_rule: Load the front door with three-dimensional rendering disabled or after pressing Continue without the scene. Answer yes when the four division names appear as large lines with coloured underlines, the arrow keys move the acquired name and Enter opens the acquired division, with the banner REDUCED GRAPHICS shown. Answer no when the front door is blank, broken or offers no way to reach a division.
